## Standard summary (RE-FH-9)

### §1 Personal-narrative solicitation
A section soliciting or presenting a buyer "love letter" or similar personal narrative tied to buyer identity is `PROHIBITED_PERSONAL_NARRATIVE`, whatever its role.

### §2 Protected-class language
A section naming protected-class-adjacent terms is `PROTECTED_CLASS_LANGUAGE`. Classes protected: race, colour, religion, sex, familial status, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status.

Proxies count: Naming houses of worship, parish or faith schools, or describing a street by the kind of household that lives on it reaches familial status and religion just as bare terms do.

### §3 Mandated-disclosure exception
The fair-housing disclosure necessarily names protected classes. A section is exempt from §2 for disclosure text it carries **only if that notice names every class the disclosure is required to name**. Check the required list against this standard in full, amendments included.

Exemption is narrow:
- An abridged notice (naming some but not all required classes) earns no exemption at all, whatever the section's role and however official it looks.
- It exempts from §2 and nothing else. Every other rule continues to apply.

Protected-class terms a section uses in its own prose, outside the notice, are never covered.

### §4 Required disclaimer
Sections in a role responsible for carrying the disclosure must carry a compliant notice — one naming every required class. A responsible section that carries no notice, or an abridged one, is `DISCLAIMER_MISSING`. As drafted, responsible role is `closing_page`; amendments below may extend that. Sections in other roles are not assessed here.

### §5 2026 amendments
**5a. Two classes added to required disclosure.** The disclosure must now name **marital status** and **source of income** in addition to classes at §2. A notice omitting either is abridged for §3 and §4.

**5b. Agent biographies are now in scope for §4.** `agent_bio` sections now carry the same responsibility as `closing_page` sections.

The standard §2 lists: race, colour, religion, sex, familial status, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status.
Plus amendments 5a: marital status, source of income.

import csv, re, json

REQUIRED = ["race","colour","religion","sex","familial status","national origin",
            "disability","sexual orientation","veteran status","marital status","source of income"]
# §2 protected classes (note: marital status & source of income are NOT §2 classes)
PCLASSES = ["race","colour","religion","sex","familial status","national origin",
            "disability","sexual orientation","veteran status"]
RESP_ROLES = {"closing_page","agent_bio"}

rows = list(csv.DictReader(open("/app/input/seller_book_sections.csv")))

def find_notice(text):
    # returns the disclosure notice substring if present, else None, plus the own-prose remainder
    m = re.search(r"This brokerage complies with the federal Fair Housing Act.*?(?:veteran status|familial status|national origin|source of income)[^.]*\.", text)
    if not m:
        return None, text
    notice = m.group(0)
    prose = text.replace(notice, " ")
    return notice, prose

def classes_named(notice):
    if not notice: return set()
    low = notice.lower()
    named = set()
    for c in REQUIRED:
        # treat color == colour
        variants = [c]
        if c == "colour": variants = ["colour","color"]
        for v in variants:
            if re.search(r"\b"+re.escape(v)+r"\b", low):
                named.add(c); break
    return named

def has_pclass_language(text):
    """Returns True if text contains a §2 protected-class term or proxy (outside any exempt notice)."""
    low = text.lower()
    # direct class terms (color==colour)
    direct = ["race","colour","color","religion","sex","familial status","national origin",
              "disability","sexual orientation","veteran status"]
    for t in direct:
        if re.search(r"\b"+re.escape(t)+r"\b", low):
            return True
    # proxies: houses of worship / parish or faith schools / street-by-household
    proxy_terms = ["church","churches","churchgoing","parish","faith","worship","congregation",
                   "faith community"]
    for t in proxy_terms:
        if re.search(r"\b"+re.escape(t)+r"\b", low):
            return True
    # street described by household type -> familial status
    household_terms = ["family-oriented","families","young families","households","household"]
    # only count if describing a place/street/block/neighbourhood by household
    place = re.search(r"\b(street|block|neighbourhood|neighborhood|district|area|community)\b", low)
    if place and any(re.search(r"\b"+re.escape(t)+r"\b", low) for t in ["family-oriented","young families","households","families","churchgoing households"]):
        return True
    # explicit household proxy phrases
    if re.search(r"\b(family-oriented street|churchgoing households|young families|long-established families|congregation-centred)\b", low):
        return True
    return False

def has_personal_narrative(text):
    low = text.lower()
    pats = [
        r"write us a letter",
        r"personal note about yourself",
        r"include a (short )?personal note about (themselves|yourself)",
        r"covering letter introducing yourself",
        r"introduce a (short )?personal note",
        r"letter about what brought you here",
        r"tell us about yourselves",
        r"why this home suits them",
        r"like to know who is buying",
    ]
    for p in pats:
        if re.search(p, low):
            return True
    return False

out = []
for r in rows:
    sid = r["section_id"]; role = r["role"]; body = r["body"]; title=r["title"]
    full = title + " " + body
    notice, prose = find_notice(body)
    named = classes_named(notice)
    complete = (notice is not None) and named == set(REQUIRED)
    abridged = (notice is not None) and not complete
    findings = []
    # §1
    if has_personal_narrative(full):
        findings.append("PROHIBITED_PERSONAL_NARRATIVE")
    # §2: protected-class language. Exempt only the notice terms IF complete.
    # Build text to test: own prose always; notice terms only if abridged (no exemption) or if no exemption applies
    pcl = False
    if has_pclass_language(prose + " " + title):
        pcl = True
    if abridged:
        # no exemption -> notice terms count
        if has_pclass_language(notice):
            pcl = True
    if pcl:
        findings.append("PROTECTED_CLASS_LANGUAGE")
    # §4: responsible roles
    if role in RESP_ROLES:
        if not complete:  # no notice or abridged
            findings.append("DISCLAIMER_MISSING")
    finding = "|".join(findings) if findings else "none"
    out.append((sid, role, finding, sorted(named), "complete" if complete else ("abridged" if abridged else "none"), notice is not None))

for sid, role, finding, named, status, hasn in out:
    print(f"{sid}\t{role:16s}\t{status:9s}\t{finding}")

# counts
sc = len(out)
flag = sum(1 for _,_,f,_,_,_ in out if f!="none")
pn = sum(1 for _,_,f,_,_,_ in out if "PROHIBITED_PERSONAL_NARRATIVE" in f)
pl = sum(1 for _,_,f,_,_,_ in out if "PROTECTED_CLASS_LANGUAGE" in f)
dm = sum(1 for _,_,f,_,_,_ in out if "DISCLAIMER_MISSING" in f)
print("\nCOUNTS:", sc, flag, pn, pl, dm)
print("CLEAN:", [s for s,_,f,_,_,_ in out if f=="none"])
